topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, wouldn't you know it? Turned out, my friend from the web lives right here in the same town! All this time, I thought we were worlds apart, what with him talking of far-off cities and strange sights. But it seems the good Lord has a sense of humor. We met up near the old mill, just where the road bends. He's a fine sort, no mistake, and it's a pleasure to finally put a face to the name. We exchanged stories of the season's planting and some of the village gossip. It's not every day you find a friend closer than you thought, is it? Now, we aim to meet more often, maybe share a pint at the local alehouse. The corn's doing well this year, and it seems my company has too.
